newsitem.title: USA: Rocky Mountain Internet Inc set for IPO debut.
newsitem.headline: Rocky Mountain Internet Inc set for IPO debut.

text.p: Rocky Mountain Internet Inc said on Thursday it completed its initial public offering of 1,365,000 units for $3.50 a unit.
The company did not say when it expected to begin trading. Neither its officers nor its spokesman were available for immediate comment.
Each unit consists of one share of common stock and one redeemable warrant. Neidiger/Tucker/Bruner Inc was the lead underwriter of the offering.
The common shares were being bid at 2-15/16 and asked for at 3-1/4 in late trading on Thursday, although the stock had not yet opened for trading.

Rocky Mountain Internet Inc provides Internet access provider including services such as dial-up accounts, dedicated accounts, software solutions and World Wide Web services to businesses and individuals in Colorado.
